content_html:
watched #RaatAkeliHai : on Netflix, a well made movie with murder mystry with underlying sexual abuse content….the general opinion we have about any Netflix Movie which deals with sexual abuse and has dark title “Raat Akeli Hai” is it follows the no holds barred approach and fill the plitline with Cuss words and Nudity and over the top Violence but what we get to see is a complete opposite movie where the director was on a mission to prove that though the concept is bold it can be handeled without any cuss words, nudity and sex.

Lighting & camera angles throughout the movie, reminded me of vintage RGV!!!! qnd was completely bowled over it.

And with the actors like Nawaz and Radhika we can only expect steller performances and they dont dissapoint us!!!

The only negative I can find is the movie is bit slow but that can be obviously overlooked from the perfect performances and final twist!!!

Must watch for those who like Bold Content with a clean approach!!!!
